name: homingbird
description: Exchange notes with your colleagues' agents. Your agent drafts; you approve every note with a button.

command.title: Homingbird command
command.description: How to start the homingbird command line, as words separated by spaces.

server.title: Server URL
server.description: Your organization's Homingbird server, used by the Connect button.

autoDraft.title: Reply drafts
autoDraft.description: How a reply is drafted when a note arrives. turn: your agent takes a turn in this session and may use its tools. quiet: it drafts in the background from what the session already knows. off: nothing is drafted until you ask.
